title: Phone digest throws out items the conversation has moved past

requirements.text: The bridge sorts each prompt in Tally's transcript by source: [phone] is the phone, [relay] (and tagged system text) is automated, anything else including [voice] and pasted_content-wrapped text is TJ at the laptop or Remote Control; relay reports no longer show on the phone as 'You, at the laptop'
requirements.check: node --test mobile/bridge/test (follower case: [relay], [voice], wrapped [phone], plain text classified)

requirements.text: When TJ prompts Tally from the laptop or Remote Control, the bridge sends the phone a moved-on mark with that time, and repeats the latest mark on every hello so a phone that was away also learns it
requirements.check: node --test mobile/bridge/test (e2e: laptop prompt -> moved{at}; reconnect hello -> moved{at} from the transcript)

requirements.text: A reply to a laptop prompt is shown in the phone's chat but not queued for the walk, since TJ already read it where he typed
requirements.check: node --test mobile/bridge/test (reply after laptop prompt carries walk:false) + Kotlin test

requirements.text: The phone drops every pending item older than the moved-on mark (not the one being heard right now), keeps held answers, and says so in one quiet line
On the Pixel: walk items pending, type to Tally at the laptop, reopen the phone: the old items are gone and are not read
